{"prompt": "def _model(self, beta):\n        \"\"\" Creates the structure of the model (model matrices, etc)\n        \n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        \n        beta : np.array\n            Contains untransformed starting values for the latent variables\n        \n        Returns\n        ----------\n        \n        lambda : np.array\n            Contains the values for the conditional volatility series\n        \n        Y : np.array\n            Contains the length-adjusted time series (accounting for lags)\n        \n        scores : np.array\n            Contains the score terms for the time series\n        \"\"\"", "output": "\n            Contains the scores of the model\n        \n        \"\"\"\n        # Create the model matrices\n        X = self.create_X(beta)\n        Y = self.create_Y(beta)\n        scores = self.create_scores(beta)\n        lambda_ = self.create_lambda(beta)\n        \n        return lambda_, Y, scores, X\n    \n    def _create_X(self, beta):\n        \"\"\" Creates the model matrices for the conditional volatility series\n        \n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        \n        beta", "solution": "\n\n        Y = np.array(self.data[self.max_lag:self.data.shape[0]])\n        X = np.ones(Y.shape[0])\n        scores = np.zeros(Y.shape[0])\n\n        # Transform latent variables\n        parm = np.array([self.latent_variables.z_list[k].prior.transform(beta[k]) for k in range(beta.shape[0])])\n        lmda = np.ones(Y.shape[0])*parm[0]\n\n        # Loop over time series\n        for t in range(0, Y.shape[0]):\n\n            if t < self.max_lag:\n\n                lmda[t] = parm[0]/(1-np.sum(parm[1:(self.p+1)]))\n\n            else:\n\n                # Working Directory and Command are\n    required and must be sent as the last two chunks in this phase. Argument and Environment chunks\n    are optional and can be sent more than once (thus we aggregate them).\n    \"\"\"", "output": "\n    request = cls()\n    while True:\n        chunk = sock.recv(cls.CHUNK_SIZE)\n        if not chunk:\n            break\n        request.add_chunk(chunk)\n        if request.is_complete():\n            break\n    return request\n\n\ndef parse_response(cls, sock):\n    \"\"\"Parse the response (the post-execution) section of the nailgun protocol from the given socket.\n\n    Handles reading of the Exit Code, Output and Error chunks from the client which represents the\n    \"response", "solution": "\n\n    command = None\n    working_dir = None\n    arguments = []\n    environment = {}\n\n    while not all((working_dir, command)):\n      chunk_type, payload = cls.read_chunk(sock)\n\n      if chunk_type == ChunkType.ARGUMENT:\n        arguments.append(payload)\n      elif chunk_type == ChunkType.ENVIRONMENT:\n        key, val = payload.split(cls.ENVIRON_SEP, 1)\n        environment[key] = val\n      elif chunk_type == ChunkType.WORKING_DIR:\n        working_dir = payload\n      elif chunk_type == ChunkType.COMMAND:\n        command = payload\n      else:\n        raise cls.ProtocolError('received non-request chunk before header was fully received!')\n\n    return working_dir, command, arguments, environment"}
